scenario: [LCAP.2.1.5] / [LDIA.3.3.7]: only a line setting a deferred capability `true` is refused. Lines restating `realtime: false` and `constspace: false` are permitted and change nothing ([LDIA.2.1]), so the program compiles; a compiler that refuses any line naming either capability reports DS_VALIDATE_REALTIME_DEFERRED instead. PATH PINNED: the deferred-setting check in override resolution in `dsc.dialect`, the arm that admits a `false` line.
rules_ds:
use default:
    realtime: false
    constspace: false

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
